data.name: Mahesh
data.gender_notes: Mahesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit mahā, 'great', + īśa, 'lord' — 'great lord'. Its root is Sanskrit mahā + īśa. An epithet of Shiva. Mahesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Great lord; Shiva”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mahesh expresses “Great lord; Shiva”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit mahā, 'great', + īśa, 'lord' — 'great lord'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahesh total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
